class Slot<T> {public List<T> Items=[];public Dictionary<string,T> Map={};public void ReplaceItems(T a,T b){Items[0]=a;Items[0]=b;}public void ReplaceGenericMap(T a,T b){Map["k"]=a;Map["k"]=b;}}
class ClassHolder {public List<Item> Items=[];public List<List<Item>> Lists=[[]];}

class Holder {public List<List<int>> Lists=[[0]];public Dictionary<string,List<int>> Map={"k":[0]};public bool ReplaceLists(){List<int>a=[1];Lists[0]=a;a.Add(2);return Lists[0].Count==2&&Lists[0][1]==2;}public bool ReplaceMap(){List<int>a=[1];Map["k"]=a;a.Add(2);return Map["k"].Count==2&&Map["k"][1]==2;}}
class Generic<T> {public List<List<T>> Lists=[];public Dictionary<string,List<T>> Map={};}

public static bool FailedOwnershipKeepsAliases(){ClassHolder h=new();Item x=new();h.Items.Add(x);List<Item> old=[new()];h.Lists[0]=old;List<Item> incoming=[x];bool caught=false;try{h.Lists[0]=incoming;}catch(NeoError e){caught=true;}old.Add(new());incoming.Clear();return caught&&h.Lists[0].Count==2&&old.Count==2&&incoming.Count==0&&h.Items.Count==1;}

public static bool DictionaryNewStoredRefuses(){Holder h=new();Holder other=new();bool caught=false;try{h.Map["new"]=other.Map["k"];}catch(NeoError e){caught=true;}return caught&&h.Map.Count==1&&other.Map["k"].Count==1;}
public static bool ListReplace(){Holder h=new();return h.ReplaceLists();}
public static bool DictionaryReplace(){Holder h=new();return h.ReplaceMap();}
public static bool ListInvalidIndex(){Holder h=new();List<int>a=[1];bool caught=false;try {h.Lists[9]=a;}catch(NeoError e){caught=true;}a.Add(2);return caught&&a.Count==2&&h.Lists[0].Count==1;}
